lessons.title: 比较结构、倒装句与强调句

questions.stem: This room is ____ larger than that one.
questions.explain: 修饰比较级可以用 much、far、a little、even 等；very 只能修饰原级，不能修饰比较级。
questions.verify: 本单元按“比较结构、倒装与强调”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.kp: the + 比较级，the + 比较级
questions.stem: The more you practice, ____ you will become.
questions.explain: “the + 比较级…，the + 比较级…”表示“越……就越……”，两部分都要有 the 和比较级。

questions.stem: The population of Shanghai is larger than ____ of Nanjing.
questions.explain: 比较的是两地的人口，不是人口和南京；用 that 代替前面提到的不可数名词 population，复数名词才用 those。

questions.kp: 否定词置于句首的倒装
questions.stem: Never ____ such a beautiful sunrise before.
questions.explain: never、seldom、hardly 等否定词放在句首时，句子要部分倒装（助动词提到主语前）；before 说明用现在完成时。

questions.stem: It was in 2010 ____ he moved to Beijing.
questions.explain: 这是强调句，强调时间状语 in 2010，用 It was…that…。检验方法：去掉 It was 和 that，剩下的 He moved to Beijing in 2010 仍是完整的句子。

questions.stem:
— I like playing basketball.
— ____. Let's play together this afternoon.
questions.explain: So + 助动词 + 主语表示“……也是这样”，助动词与前句一致（like → do）。So I do 是“我确实如此”，用来肯定自己说过的话。

questions.stem: This is the ____ (good) film I have ever seen.
questions.explain: the + 最高级 + 名词 + I have ever seen 是常见的最高级句型；good 的比较级、最高级不规则：better、best。

questions.kp: so + 副词置于句首的倒装
questions.stem: So hard ____ he work that he passed the exam easily.
questions.explain: so + 形容词 / 副词放在句首时要部分倒装：原句 He worked so hard that…，倒装后加助动词 did，worked 还原为 work。
